GAB.note: Mediation is run by the CNEF under COBAC supervision; no central bank payments role stated.

facts.fact: CEMAC Regulation 01/20 of 3 July 2020 on consumer protection for banking products and services, with a Prime Minister's decree of 21 March 2024 and two ministerial arrets of 7 January 2025, sets the financial mediation framework, covering payment institutions and mobile money disputes.

GAB.note: The mediation launch was scheduled for 26 October 2026 (forward notice; mediator named by arrete in June 2026), so no redress fact is recorded.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Names only the consumer-protection regulation, not a payments law.
CEMAC banking consumer-protection regulation is not stated to be digital law.
Mobile money mentioned only as a dispute subject, no service described.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
